top3.headline: Northflank tells every user to rotate all secrets after a breach
top3.whyItMatters: Stolen AI keys turn into real bills and data exposure; check every hosting vendor today.

top3.headline: Investors turn on AI spending as Alphabet sheds over $500bn
top3.whyItMatters: Boards will ask harder questions about AI returns, including about your own budget.

top3.headline: Four major AI labs back a single opt-out from AI scraping
top3.whyItMatters: Content owners get one switch for AI training and grounding access across major labs.

items.title: Drew Breunig and Claude Opus put an NES chip inside Qwen's weights
items.takeaway: Super Mario Bros runs, very slowly, inside Qwen3.5-4B; Opus found and used 15-year-old CPU conformance tests.
items.soWhat: Agents can take on deep, odd engineering work when good tests exist, so invest in test suites.

image.alt: Simon Willison: Drew Breunig and Claude Opus put an NES chip inside Qwen's weights

items.title: Altman: scarce RAM belongs in data centers, not personal computers
items.takeaway: On Cheeky Pint, Altman called it 'quite terrible' for the world's limited DRAM to sit in PCs for local inference.
items.soWhat: OpenAI's CEO argues against local AI, so check how much your plans depend on cloud capacity.

items.title: a16z: GPU rents rose while token prices fell 58% since July
items.takeaway: Since mid-July, B300 rentals rose 106% and H100 17%, while average token prices fell 58%.
items.soWhat: Buying AI as tokens keeps getting cheaper while renting GPUs gets pricier; weigh that in build decisions.

image.alt: Image from a16z Charts of the Week

items.title: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic back one AI scraping opt-out
items.takeaway: A shared robots.txt policy token lets publishers opt out of AI scraping across companies at once; Anthropic already supports it.
items.soWhat: Publishers will soon set AI access once for all major labs, so decide what your content allows.

items.title: Perplexity says Gemini 4 Carbon sets a new deep-research high
items.takeaway: Aravind Srinivas called it the strongest research model Perplexity has seen, coming to Pro and Max users when capacity allows.
items.soWhat: Gemini 4 Carbon now has an outside endorsement for research work; test it against your current default.

items.title: Investors punish AI spending: Intel falls 28%, Nasdaq ends October down
items.takeaway: Alphabet lost over $500bn in value Thursday after saying AI search summaries hit ad revenue; Intel dropped 28% Friday.
items.soWhat: Markets now question AI spending, so expect pressure to show returns on your own AI budget.

items.title: Northflank breach: users told to rotate every secret now
items.takeaway: Northflank told all users to assume environment variables were decrypted; several users confirmed their AI keys were used.
items.soWhat: If any team runs on Northflank, rotate every key today, starting with AI provider keys.

voices.quote: Assume all environment variables have been decrypted. Disable/rotate all keys.
they assume that the problem is solved now because we are going to have open-source models, we're going to be able to run them on our computers
